# State AI Compliance Cost Model

> A bottom-up, auditable estimate of what state-by-state AI regulation costs a company beyond a
> single hypothetical federal standard. All 89 state AI laws passed in the 2026 session were
> double-coded by LLM from enacted texts against a fixed protocol; every coded value is anchored
> to a quoted statutory provision. Cost = duty hours × rates; reuse between states and the
> federal baseline are derived from coded statutory parameters, never assigned. Built for a16z;
> maintained at github.com/elliotjames-paschal/state-ai-compliance-cost.

Key concepts: a law is coded as duties (work it demands — each carrying hour estimates for the
average AI model) and parameters (settings it picks — whose cross-state agreement sets the reuse
discount and the federal-baseline exclusion). Only company-binding laws enter the estimate;
criminal, agency, and school laws are excluded by default. Statutory penalties are reported as
fact, never added to cost. Headline is a Monte Carlo range; the conservative end leads.

## Pages

- [State Law Explorer](https://elliotjames-paschal.github.io/state-ai-compliance-cost/#explorer): map of all 2026 state AI bills with live LegiScan status, votes, and links
- [Cost Model](https://elliotjames-paschal.github.io/state-ai-compliance-cost/#model): the interactive estimate — every assumption is a control
- [Glossary](https://elliotjames-paschal.github.io/state-ai-compliance-cost/#glossary): reference for every term, duty, and parameter

## Data & methods

- [Methodology (one page, PDF)](https://elliotjames-paschal.github.io/state-ai-compliance-cost/docs/methodology.pdf)
- [CODING.md](https://github.com/elliotjames-paschal/state-ai-compliance-cost/blob/main/CODING.md): the fixed coding protocol — families, duty triggers, parameter vocabularies, rules
- [data/bills.js](https://github.com/elliotjames-paschal/state-ai-compliance-cost/blob/main/data/bills.js): the coded dataset the dashboard runs on (quote-anchored)
- [coding/](https://github.com/elliotjames-paschal/state-ai-compliance-cost/tree/main/coding): full coding records — both independent passes, adjudications, flags, confidence
- [texts/](https://github.com/elliotjames-paschal/state-ai-compliance-cost/tree/main/texts): the enacted statute texts with per-bill provenance manifests
- [README.md](https://github.com/elliotjames-paschal/state-ai-compliance-cost/blob/main/README.md): project overview and status

Bill status data via LegiScan (CC BY 4.0).
